import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    inp = data[1]
    maxl = -1
    curl = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ch = inp[i]
        if ch == '_':
            if curl > maxl:
                maxl = curl
            curl = 0
            i += 1
            continue
        elif ch != '(' and ch != ')':
            curl += 1
            i += 1
        else:
            if curl > maxl:
                maxl = curl
            curl = 0
            i += 1
            while i < n and inp[i] != ')':
                i += 1
            i += 1  # skip the ')'
    if curl > maxl:
        maxl = curl

    numwrd = 0
    curl = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        while i < n and inp[i] != '(':
            i += 1
        if i == n:
            break
        i += 1  # skip '('
        while i < n and inp[i] != ')':
            if inp[i] == '_':
                if curl > 0:
                    numwrd += 1
                curl = 0
            else:
                curl += 1
            i += 1
        if curl > 0:
            numwrd += 1
        curl = 0
        i += 1  # skip ')'

    print(f"{maxl} {numwrd}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
